fusions.name: Snare Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a weighted snare that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: A blow on an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shut Every Door
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trapper's Instinct
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
